headline: Profit rebounds q/q but trails a swollen year-ago quarter
summary_short: Revenue was $29.94B, down 4.8% q/q and 1.2% y/y, while net income fell to $3.53B (-68.3% y/y) as EBIT and EBITDA both dropped sharply against an outsized year-ago quarter.
summary_long: Revenue $29.94B (-4.8% q/q, -1.2% y/y). Operating margin ~17.2% (+~410bps q/q, -~253bps y/y); gross margin ~72.0% (+~658bps q/q, -~303bps y/y). Diluted EPS $0.99 (+65.0% q/q, -66.8% y/y); net income $3.53B (+62.2% q/q, -68.3% y/y). Cash $7.66B (-19.1% q/q, -20.9% y/y); shareholders' equity $89.76B (+1.7% q/q, -7.3% y/y).
